correctness.rationale: Independent PGF factorization yields a unique, real logarithmic series; root-modulus bound supplies absolutely summable nonnegative jump rates exactly on the admitted side. Off that side a zero in the numerator produces a nearer nonpositive-axis singularity and Pringsheim forces a negative log coefficient; nonnegative-integer infinite divisibility requires positive compound-Poisson jump rates. All parameter endpoints and boundary equality addressed. 126 rational exact-arithmetic parameter configurations were checked; finite checks are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The zero-inflated negative-binomial family is a standard model for excess count zeros. This theorem gives a complete sharp integer-shape parameter diagram with an explicit compound-Poisson construction on one side and a rigorous obstruction on the other. The discontinuity across shapes two and three and exact thresholds 1/9 and 1/65 at q=1/2 are qualitative structural information beyond generic moment or normalization calculations.
